description: PLATEAU's dangling group member fixture (Z-common-01_xlink_02): one grp:groupMember names a gml:id that is in no document. The reader drops a link it cannot resolve, so the writer writes the group with its one resolvable member and its grp:parent as xlink:href links and reports the lost member as citygml.empty_value_not_written. New-world only: the legacy writer does not nest objects and does not write groups.
